metadata.description: Cong thuc giai tich lop 12: dao ham, tich phan, gioi han

formulas.name: derivative_constant
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua hang so bang 0

formulas.name: derivative_power_rule
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua x mu n bang n nhan x mu (n-1)
formulas.description_en: Power rule: derivative of x^n is n*x^(n-1)

formulas.name: derivative_sum_rule
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua tong bang tong cac dao ham
formulas.description_en: Sum rule: derivative of sum equals sum of derivatives

formulas.name: derivative_product_rule
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua tich: (uv)' = u'v + uv'

formulas.name: derivative_quotient_rule
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua thuong: (u/v)' = (u'v - uv') / v^2

formulas.name: derivative_chain_rule
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham ham hop: lay dao ham ngoai nhan dao ham trong
formulas.description_en: Chain rule: derivative of composite function

formulas.name: derivative_exp
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua e mu x bang chinh no

formulas.name: derivative_ln
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua ln(x) bang 1/x

formulas.name: derivative_sin
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua sin(x) bang cos(x)

formulas.name: derivative_cos
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua cos(x) bang -sin(x)

formulas.name: derivative_tan
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua tan(x) bang 1/cos^2(x)

formulas.name: derivative_sqrt
formulas.description_vi: Dao ham cua can x bang 1/(2 can x)

formulas.name: integral_power_rule
formulas.description_vi: Nguyen ham cua x mu n (n khac -1)

formulas.name: integral_exp
formulas.description_vi: Nguyen ham cua e^x bang e^x + C
formulas.description_en: Integral of e^x is e^x + C

formulas.name: integral_1_over_x
formulas.description_vi: Nguyen ham cua 1/x bang ln|x| + C

formulas.name: integral_sin
formulas.description_vi: Nguyen ham cua sin(x) bang -cos(x) + C

formulas.name: integral_cos
formulas.description_vi: Nguyen ham cua cos(x) bang sin(x) + C
formulas.description_en: Integral of cos(x) is sin(x) + C

formulas.name: definite_integral_area
formulas.description_vi: Dien tich hinh phang gioi han boi hai do thi
formulas.description_en: Area between two curves using definite integral

formulas.name: volume_revolution
formulas.description_vi: The tich khoi tron xoay quanh truc Ox
formulas.description_en: Volume of solid of revolution around x-axis
examples: V = pi * integral(0,1) x^2 dx = pi/3

formulas.name: extrema_first_derivative
formulas.name_vi: Cuc tri theo dao ham cap 1
formulas.formula: f'(x0) = 0 va f' doi dau qua x0 => cuc tri
formulas.description_vi: Diem cuc tri khi dao ham bang 0 va doi dau
formulas.description_en: Extrema occurs when f'=0 and f' changes sign

formulas.name: extrema_second_derivative
formulas.name_vi: Cuc tri theo dao ham cap 2
formulas.formula: f'(x0) = 0: f''(x0) > 0 => cuc tieu, f''(x0) < 0 => cuc dai
formulas.description_vi: Kiem tra cuc tri bang dao ham cap 2

formulas.name: vertical_asymptote
formulas.formula: lim(x->a) f(x) = +-infinity => x = a la tiem can dung
formulas.description_vi: Duong thang x = a la tiem can dung khi gioi han la vo cung
formulas.description_en: Vertical asymptote when limit is infinity
examples: y = 1/(x-2): x = 2 la tiem can dung

formulas.name: horizontal_asymptote
formulas.formula: lim(x->+-infinity) f(x) = b => y = b la tiem can ngang
formulas.description_vi: Duong thang y = b la tiem can ngang khi gioi han huu han
formulas.description_en: Horizontal asymptote when limit at infinity is finite
examples: y = (2x+1)/(x-1): y = 2 la tiem can ngang

formulas.name: tangent_line_equation
formulas.description_vi: Phuong trinh tiep tuyen cua do thi tai diem (x0, y0)
formulas.description_en: Equation of tangent line at point (x0, y0)

formulas.name: limit_lhopital
formulas.formula: lim f/g = lim f'/g' (dang 0/0 hoac inf/inf)
formulas.description_vi: Ap dung khi gioi han co dang vo dinh 0/0 hoac inf/inf
